papers.title: StepAudio 3 Realtime Technical Report
papers.desc: Realtime spoken interaction demands deep reasoning, prompt responses, and fluid turn-taking.

papers.title: The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.desc: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables AI systems to turn experience and feedback into persistent changes that improve both their capabilities and the process of future improvement.

papers.title: StepAudio 3 Music Technical Report
papers.desc: We introduce StepAudio 3 Music, a large-scale, long-form music generation model that supports explicit musical planning and open-domain text-controlled generation.

papers.title: HarnessVLN: Unifying Training-Free Embodied Navigation through an Agent Harness
papers.desc: Embodied navigation requires agents to interpret visual observations, accumulate spatial knowledge, and execute actions to follow instructions or locate objects.

papers.title: Another Blueprint In The Wall: How to Ask Frontier AI Like a Kid?
papers.desc: This paper reports experiments across six frontier model types from OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and Google DeepMind.

papers.title: ModularRSI: Modular and Generalizable Recursive Harness Self-Improvement
papers.desc: Recent work extends recursive self-improvement (RSI) to agent harnesses for long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, enabling agents to improve execution mechanisms from experience.

papers.title: Modality-Autoregressive World-Action Models
papers.desc: World-action models (WAMs) jointly model future observations and actions, typically predicting the future as RGB images.

papers.title: PhysStream: Streaming Physics-Grounded Video Generation with Structured Scene Memory and Fine-Grained Motion Control
papers.desc: Interactive control for video generation is moving from coarse prompts toward fine-grained, physically meaningful manipulation of dynamic scenes.

papers.title: ImpossibleRubrics: Stress-Testing Generated Rubrics as Reward Signals
papers.desc: Language model-generated rubrics are increasingly used as reward signals for rubric-based reinforcement learning, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and automated grading.

papers.title: Convergent Emergence of In-Context Learning Across Modalities
papers.desc: Few-shot in-context learning (ICL), the capacity of a model to infer abstract patterns from input-output examples provided in its prompt and apply them to new inputs, has been extensively studied in large language models trained for next-token prediction on human text.

papers.title: Decoy Direction Optimization: A Post-Hoc Defense Against LLM Abliteration
papers.desc: Safety guardrails in open-weight language models can be readily bypassed using Refusal Feature Ablation (RFA), a technique that identifies and projects out a linear refusal direction from the residual stream, often achieving a high attack success rate (ASR) while preserving model capability.

papers.title: Emergence World: Adversarial Stress-Testing of Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems
papers.desc: As AI agents move from bounded tasks to persistent deployments, failures can propagate through memory, tools, other agents, and environmental state long after their interactions.

papers.title: Drift-Constrained Optimization: Only Direction Matters in Fine-Tuning Instruct Models
papers.desc: Fine-tuning instruct models often improves target performance while inducing behavioral drift from the reference model, which can degrade existing capabilities.

papers.title: Generalized Agent Iteration: One Formal Framework for Iterative Policy Improvement and Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.desc: When we speak of recursive self-improvement (RSI), are we speaking of a phenomenon, a mechanism, or a prospect? Towards autonomous and evolving intelligence, RSI is being claimed at many scales, while no single framework that formally describes these emerging instances exists.

papers.title: OmniHarness: Harnessing Generalizable Visual Generation via Symbolic Policy Learning
papers.desc: Unified multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and multi-agent systems have advanced visual generation.
